summary: Install-time HTTP beacon to hardcoded bare IP in setup.py
details: setup.py performs an unconditional HTTP GET at install time to the hardcoded bare IP endpoint http://167.233.212.138/cb/db27bcff144c059f/trtllm_subdir_test. The path segment is a package-specific token, so each install signals the beacon operator that this package resolved and executed on a given host, leaking install occurrence plus network metadata (source IP, timing) to a non-publisher destination. The package name and version (99999.0.0) are consistent with a dependency-confusion probe targeting an internal name.
